transformations.description: Copies the six published Line 3/4 ordered sections independently. No reverse pattern, branch concatenation or cross-pattern handoff edge is generated.
Copies 15 accepted Cartagena StopNode/StopPlace identities exactly from prior accepted scenarios.
Uses official operator-linked map/directions coordinates for 101 newly created identities; these are Grade C, not surveyed platform geometry.
Derives only package-local center/bounds while preserving the accepted es-cartagena settlement canonical fields exactly.

warnings: The project label 'legacy' is a scenario-family label; this package models the current published snapshot captured on 2026-08-13.

Line 4's public title 'P. Mediterráneo - Canteras' and its detailed source-section terminology use Pol. Cabezo Beaza/Galifa termini; both source forms are preserved rather than reconciled by renaming.
StopNode.sourceReferences are empty for all new identities because no genuine OpenStreetMap node/way was reconciled.
Operator spellings such as 'LOS CANALES AVDA.DEL PROTUS I' are preserved from the official stop source rather than silently corrected.
Later Cartagena components must reuse every shared accepted StopNode/StopPlace object from this scenario exactly.
